note: Paragraphs Sets inserts a pre-configured group of paragraphs into a Paragraphs field in one click. A set is a config entity 'paragraphs_set' (config prefix paragraphs_sets.set.*, exported keys id/label/description/icon_uuid/paragraphs; paragraphs = list of {bundle, data}). Managed at /admin/structure/paragraphs_set (configure route entity.paragraphs_set.collection, permission 'administer paragraphs sets'). It also adds widget third-party settings (use_paragraphs_sets/sets_allowed/default_set) on the stable 'paragraphs' widget. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the paragraphs_set config entity (standalone, safe): sets reference real paragraph bundles present on this site (e.g. bp_callout, bp_simple). Introspection reads a known set; execution creates a set (single- or multi-paragraph) verified against live config. Fixtures are namespaced ps_* config entities, removed on cleanup; no other module's fields are touched.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal paragraphs_sets module let a content editor do, and what config entity stores a set?
evals.expected_output: It lets editors insert a whole pre-configured group of paragraphs into a Paragraphs field in one click. A set is stored as a paragraphs_set config entity (config prefix paragraphs_sets.set.*) listing paragraphs as {bundle, data}.

evals.prompt: How do I turn on Paragraphs Sets for a specific Paragraphs field, and which widget setting keys control it?
evals.expected_output: On the field's Manage form display, use the Paragraphs (stable) widget and tick 'Enable Paragraphs Sets'. The keys are use_paragraphs_sets (enable), sets_allowed (limit which sets), default_set (seed default value); stored under third_party_settings.paragraphs_sets on the form-display component.

evals.prompt: A paragraphs_sets set's static 'data' only handles simple default field values. How do I provide complex/dynamic default field values for a set?
evals.expected_output: Implement one of the alter hooks: hook_paragraphs_set_data_alter() (all sets), hook_paragraphs_set_SET_data_alter() (one set), or hook_paragraphs_set_SET_FIELD_NAME_data_alter() (one field in one set). They receive &$data and a $context array; see paragraphs_sets.api.php.

evals.prompt: On this site a Paragraphs set with id 'ps_probe' has been created with paragraphs_sets. Inspect the live configuration and report which paragraph bundle (paragraph type) that set contains.
evals.expected_output: The set ps_probe contains one paragraph of bundle bp_callout. Read config paragraphs_sets.set.ps_probe (its 'paragraphs' list) or load the paragraphs_set entity.

evals.prompt: On this site, paragraphs_sets has a set whose label is 'Landing Hero Set'. Inspect the live Paragraphs set configuration and report that set's machine id.
evals.expected_output: The machine id is ps_named (config paragraphs_sets.set.ps_named, label 'Landing Hero Set').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (paragraphs_sets is enabled), create a Paragraphs set with machine id 'ps_task' and label 'Task Set' that contains a single paragraph of type 'bp_simple'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a paragraphs_set config entity id 'ps_task', label 'Task Set', paragraphs [{bundle: bp_simple, data: {}}] (ParagraphsSet::create([...])->save(), or via /admin/structure/paragraphs_set/add). Verify loads it and checks label and the paragraph bundle.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (paragraphs_sets is enabled), create a Paragraphs set with machine id 'ps_multi' and label 'Multi Set' that contains TWO paragraphs in order: first a 'bp_callout', then a 'bp_simple'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a paragraphs_set config entity id 'ps_multi', label 'Multi Set', paragraphs [{bundle: bp_callout, data: {}}, {bundle: bp_simple, data: {}}]. Verify checks there are exactly 2 paragraphs and bundle[0]=bp_callout, bundle[1]=bp_simple.
